skill_name: Compose a persuasive essay discussing the merits of a plant-based diet.
workflow: A plant-based diet has a vast array of benefits that can dramatically improve human health and help reduce the environmental impacts of food production. The absence of animal products in a plant-based diet provides essential nutrients that are essential for maintaining good health. By omitting animal products, the body can no longer be exposed to the high levels of fats and cholesterol found in processed meats, dairy and eggs.
